worked_solution:
Using the properties of addition/subtraction and scalar multiplication of vectors to isolate $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}2a+5x & =b \\ 5x & =b-2a \\ x & =\frac{1}{5}(b-2a) \\ x & =\frac{1}{5}([\begin{aligned}15 \\ -30 \\ 20\end{aligned}]-2[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -5 \\ -10\end{aligned}]) \\ x & =\frac{1}{5}[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -20 \\ 40\end{aligned}] \\ x & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -4 \\ 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
